D008_l001.question:
A 75-year-old married male author presents with a two-week history of an elevated and expansive mood, accompanied by a notable increase in energy. During this period, he exhibited inflated self-confidence, a reduced need for sleep, increased distractibility by extraneous stimuli, and social hyperactivity, all representing a marked change from his typical demeanor. This presentation was associated with significant functional impairment.

Preceding this, approximately one month prior, the patient experienced a period characterized by emotional blunting, chronic fatigue, and middle insomnia. He reported ruminative guilt and indecisiveness during this time. Of note, he endorsed a suicide attempt during this depressive episode, which also led to significant functional impairment. The described demographics (e.g., marital status, occupation) are not temporally related to the onset of the current symptoms.
D008_l001.options:
A. Schizoaffective Disorder (Depressive Type)
    B. Bipolar I Disorder with Psychotic Features
    C. Schizoaffective Disorder (Bipolar Type)
    D. Bipolar I Disorder
